name: PT Wijaya Karya Beton Tbk
summary: PT Wijaya Karya Beton Tbk, together with its subsidiaries provides pre-stressed concrete (PC) products in Indonesia and internationally. The company operates through Concrete, Quarry, and Service segments. It also offers pile products comprising of hollow round and box piles, massive box piles, cylinder pile, and triangular piles. In addition, the company provides PC piles, such as spun, square, and triangular piles; and railway concrete products, such as PC turnout sleepers, catenary poles, concrete level crossing, and slab track; and bridge concrete products.
